objective: Preallocate join group aggregate left-side row buckets for their first row.

tasks.title: Preallocate join group left buckets
tasks.result: Join group aggregate fast path now creates new left-side row buckets with capacity for the immediately inserted first row.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default temp location has previously been unreliable for this workspace.
Before rerunning verification, Cargo-generated PDB files under target/debug were removed after path verification to avoid MSVC PDB limit and disk pressure failures.
The bucket capacity is 1 because a new join group left-side bucket is immediately followed by the first matching row push.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for new left-side row buckets; join key grouping, aggregate computation, and result semantics are unchanged.
